rows.name: Steakhouse Financial

value_model.cat_basis: overall median (too few live comps in category)

farm_steps: Open a fresh wallet for this farm only, write the seed phrase on paper and store it offline. Never reuse a wallet that holds your main funds.
Deposit $1,000 of USDC into Steakhouse Financial's curator vault on Base and hold the vault receipt in the farming wallet.
Allocate a second $500 to a different vault run by Steakhouse Financial on Base, so the wallet shows two distinct vault positions.
Once a week, repeat the main action with $250 or top up the existing position, so the wallet shows steady use rather than one burst.
Keep the position open for at least 90 days. Do not close it early: snapshots reward wallets that were present over time, not wallets that farmed and left.
Bridge $500 to Ethereum and repeat the main action there, so the position exists on two chains and the wallet is counted on both.
Once a week, open Steakhouse Financial's points or quest page and check the farming wallet shows the position and any points earned; if it does not, fix it before the next week.
Log every transaction hash, the date and the amount in a note. If a claim opens, the log is the proof of what the wallet did and when.

farm_steps: Open a fresh wallet for this farm only, write the seed phrase on paper and store it offline. Never reuse a wallet that holds your main funds.
Allocate $100 of USDC into IPOR Fusion's allocator vault on Base and keep the vault position open.
Allocate a second $50 to a different vault run by IPOR Fusion on Base, so the wallet shows two distinct vault positions.
Once a week, repeat the main action with $25 or top up the existing position, so the wallet shows steady use rather than one burst.
Keep the position open for at least 90 days. Do not close it early: snapshots reward wallets that were present over time, not wallets that farmed and left.
Bridge $50 to Ethereum and repeat the main action there, so the position exists on two chains and the wallet is counted on both.
Once a week, open IPOR Fusion's points or quest page and check the farming wallet shows the position and any points earned; if it does not, fix it before the next week.
Log every transaction hash, the date and the amount in a note. If a claim opens, the log is the proof of what the wallet did and when.
